infobox.leads to: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 4, The Huntsman Path - Secured Perimeter

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I see you're quite a good shot, kid. Sniper said he wants to test your reaction time. The faster one wins, as he says. As in that film, remember, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly", only with a bolt-action rifle instead of a revolver. Life here certainly isn’t a movie, but the reaction and the choice of position are very important in the firefight, especially in urban conditions. If you survive this, help yourself to my cowboy hat, I have one around here somewhere. You choose yourself, who you want to be: the good, the bad, or the ugly."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 3 PMCs from less than 25 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,500 EXP
- Jaeger Rep +0.02
- 70,000 Roubles
  - 73,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 80,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake
- 1× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad
- Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake at Jaeger LL2
- Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad at Jaeger LL2
- Unlocks craft for .366 TKM AP-M at Workbench level 3
- Unlocks Colored Hideout shooting range target style
"You have got a good reaction time since you're still standing here. Grab your new hat, as promised! Go on, shooter, new tests await you."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
To do this quest, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18. Factory is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at 25m or closer.

You can use the M7290 grenade, the Zarya grenade or a KS-23M with the Zvezda flashbang round to flash and stun PMC'S and make them easier targets.
